instruction: Buy me a compass from my amazon wishlist that will fit in my hiking backpack pocket of 4.0X2.5 (LxW) inches.
notes: Single-app task (amazon) plus supervisor. The wish list is read once (nullary wish-list-known), then show_product (no token needed) reveals each candidate compass's dimensions; add_product_to_cart is only allowed for a wish-listed compass whose length<=4.0 and width<=2.5, and requires an empty cart (clear_cart first) so the resulting order contains exactly one item. Payment card and address ids are discovered via amazon.show_payment_cards / amazon.show_addresses (known-id on a record supertype), then place_order creates the order. Existing addresses are never modified. supervisor.complete_task takes the ordered product as a non-API record parameter so its precondition mirrors the goal (ordered fitting compass); no answer is passed since the task is not a question.
